clauses.requirement: The lamp's photometric performance shall be verified against the standard light distributions specified in UN R148 Annex 3.
The provisions of Annex 3 paragraph 1 (reference axis, grid interpretation and uniformity of light distribution) shall apply unless otherwise specified.

Unless otherwise specified, the direction H = 0° and V = 0° shall correspond to the reference axis (on the vehicle horizontal, parallel to the median longitudinal plane and oriented in the required direction of visibility) passing through the centre of reference; the values in Figures A3-I to A3-XV shall give the minimum intensities for each measurement direction as a percentage of the minimum intensities required, mathematically rounded down to three significant digits; where a front or rear direction indicator, front or rear position lamp, front or rear end-outline marker lamp, parking lamp, stop lamp of category S1, S2 or MS, or side marker lamp is installed at a mounting height (H plane specified by the manufacturer) of 750 mm or less above the ground, photometric intensity shall be verified only up to 5° downwards.

Within the light distribution field shown as a grid, the light pattern shall be substantially uniform, i.e. the intensity in each direction within a part of the field formed by grid lines shall meet at least the lowest minimum value shown on the surrounding grid lines as a percentage; for reversing lamps, if visual examination reveals substantial local variations of intensity, a check shall ensure that no intensity measured between two of the measurement directions is below 50 per cent of the lower of the two minimum intensities prescribed for those directions.
The lamp shall conform to the standard light distribution given in Annex 3 paragraph 2.

The standard light distribution for front and rear position lamps, parking lamps, front and rear end-outline marker lamps, stop lamps (S1, S2 and MS) and direction indicator lamps of categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a, 2b, 11, 11a, 11b, 11c and 12 shall be met, the values shown giving for each measurement direction the minimum intensities as a percentage of the minimum intensities required (see Tables 3, 4, 5, 7 and 8).

The rear position lamp and stop lamp light distribution shall conform to Figure A3-I, the standard light distribution for front and rear position, parking, end-outline marker, stop and direction indicator lamps.

For daytime running lamps, the standard light distribution values shall give for each measurement direction the minimum intensities as a percentage of the minimum intensity required (see Table 6); applicable only if the product includes a daytime running lamp function.
